properties.name: Two redundant closures collapsed to the associated function itself (NodeDto::from / EdgeDto::from), after CI's `cargo clippy -p reflow2-mcp --all-targets -- -D warnings` rejected them. No design meaning: the bulk forms behave identically, and every test that names their behaviour is unchanged and still passing. The reason this reached CI at all is BL-159 — AGENTS.md's documented gate list omitted that clippy invocation, so the local run was green against the list as written.
